mandatory_text_sc1: Each interval is a marginal 95% interval. {K} intervals were computed from the same images (variants x cells x two contrasts); they are positively dependent and no familywise or false-discovery adjustment was made. If every true difference were zero, about 5% of them (about {0.05 K}) would still exclude zero, and the count of intervals that exclude zero is not a calibrated tally because of the dependence. An interval that excludes zero is therefore a descriptive observation, not a finding; patterns across rows and cells are described, single intervals are not claims. The intervals cover item sampling only: refit-seed variation and design-item sampling are not in them.
